BiblicalUsage: Yoneqeth is a sprout, a young shoot, and it grows in three different pictures. In Job 8:16 a hypocrite's shoot is "green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden," and in Psalms 80:11 the vine of Israel "sent out her boughs unto the sea." In Ezekiel 17:22 God himself takes "a tender one" from the top of the cedar and plants it, and it grows into a tree.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a sprout is how God talks about beginnings, and the shoot in Ezekiel 17:22 is God's own planting, taken from the top of the tree and set where he chooses, so my beginnings, however small, are in his hands.
